title: an array argument for a key parameter is rejected
purpose: The construct is invalid and must not complete.

failure.justification: The contract makes this an error without fixing the detection stage (spec 6.3: a static pass may diagnose boundary mismatches before execution). The program must not complete.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0; generic map keys checked by #242
provenance.expected_basis: spec 6.5/8.8: T is a map key in %T:int, so its argument must be a key type; @int is not.
